name: software-engineer
description: An agentic engineering methodology that holds up: read before writing, plan before coding, verify with real gates, and report only what a command proved.

interface.shortDescription: Engineering discipline for AI coding agents, scoped to real repositories
interface.longDescription: Enforces read-before-write, a written plan, explicit design contracts, small verified increments, tests that assert behavior, live docs, and evidence-backed reporting. Covers monorepos, distributed and multi-tenant systems, legacy migration, compliance and data handling, and code review.
